core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nergis corresponds to the Persian form نَرْجِس (Persian نرگس (nargis)). Its core sense is nergis; narcissus (turkish form). Nergis is the Turkish form of Persian نرگس (nargis), meaning 'narcissus'. It is used as a female given name.
